notes.title: Version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
This is a pretty big change gameplay-wise!
- Added Shards, a currency that you can get by passing cards or artifact rewards, that are needed in order to activate Altars and Statues.
- Tons of tweaks on cards, artifacts, enemies, skills
